text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff
font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202a30

g.text: Prepare chemicals
Weigh each ligand once into its labelled vial.
Prepare the two bulk workup liquids.
Load weighed chemicals; NO stock solvent yet.
The robot will add stock solvent.
Five labelled working vials start empty.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff
font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202a30

g.text: Load once and start
Start STOCK HOLDER on heater-shaker 10.
Leave slot 1 empty; load other mapped labware.
Import run_screen.py; complete App checks.
One local program runs all OT-2 stages.
Follow its numbered pauses and move prompts.
Use the same labware and tip racks throughout.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff
font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202a30

g.text: Make stocks, then dose 48 reactions
Keep stock holder on 10 for making/shaking stocks.
Then move 10 → 1 at the App prompt.
Reaction sources open; analytical vials capped.
Add solvent → pipette-mix → shake stocks
750 rpm / 2 min, heater OFF → move to 1 → dose.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff
font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202a30

g.text: Seal and start the heated hold
Screw on all 48 REACTION caps.
Cover reservoir / LC plate.
REACTION BLOCK 3 → 10; start timer at 4b.
Heat to 95 °C; shake at 500 rpm.
Nominal 4-hour hold starts at the App prompt.
Then stop heating and shaking.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff
font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202a30

g.text: After the hold: prepare standards while reactions cool
At the prompt: SEALED BLOCK 10 → 3.
Uncover reservoir / LC plate; open the ten
analytical vials. Reaction caps stay ON.
Make analytical stocks and seven standards
in LC wells A7–G7 while the sealed reaction
block cools. Keep the LC plate in slot 6.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff
font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202a30

g.text: Open cooled reactions, quench and mix
Operator decides when safe to open and
module is ready for unheated workup. Uncap
reactions; OPEN BLOCK 3 → 10 → 3 at prompts.
Add 400 µL quench / reaction (500 µL total).
Shake open block: 750 rpm / 2 min, heater OFF.
Return to slot 3, then wait 15 s.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff
font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202a30

g.text: Prepare LC samples: aliquot first, then diluent
No labware move or manual pipetting.
Leave the LC plate in slot 6.
For each of six columns: transfer eight
20 µL extract aliquots with fresh tips FIRST.
Then add 480 µL diluent / well (2 × 240 µL)
with the eight-channel pipette.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff
font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202a30

g.text: Mix the completed LC plate
Recap reactions for storage.
At the prompt: UNCOVERED LC PLATE 6 → 10.
Remove the plate when the App requests it.
Mix 48 samples + seven standards:
750 rpm / 2 min, heater OFF.
Each filled LC well contains 500 µL.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff
font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202a30

g.text: Take to HPLC-MS, then calculate yields
Seal / label the LC plate; mark A1.
Finish the robot program, then carry the plate
flat to HPLC-MS with lc-injections.csv.
LC: medium-polarity, 3-min method.
Check 7 standards FIRST, then 48 samples.
55 injections = 165 min + overhead.
SOFTWARE: yields / QC; save data and logs.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 21px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #202a30

g.text: From weighed chemicals to measured yields

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #53636c

g.text: One 48-reaction screen • Same step numbers as the staff guide and App

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #28576c

g.text: STAFF / HANDS-ON

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #345841

g.text: OT-2 / AUTOMATIC

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #202a30

g.text: Move labware only at the App prompts. Read both columns, then follow the numbered staff guide.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #53636c

g.text: Longer hold: remain at 4b until the agreed endpoint. Holds / waits are logged. Keep reaction caps ON during cooling.
